# hpe_opsramp_kb_article (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp Knowledge Base Article.


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_opsramp_kb_article" "kb_article_default" {
  subject     = "Default article"
  content     = "Default article's description"
  category_id = hpe_opsramp_kb_category.kb_category_default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The full content/body of the KB article (may contain HTML).
- `subject` (String) The subject of the KB article.

### Optional

- `attachment_ids` (List of String) The IDs of attachments
- `category_id` (String) The string ID of the KB category this article belongs to.
- `client` (String) The client (tenant) UUID where this article should be created. If not specified, uses the provider's tenant.
- `expiry_date` (String) The expiry date of the article in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2025-12-31T23:59:59Z`)
- `linked_article_ids` (List of String) The IDs of linked articles

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The string ID of the KB article, assigned by the API.
- `state` (String) The publication status of the article. (`PUBLISHED`, `TRASH`).
